changes_made.explanation: Added BERT as it's explicitly used in the baseline model (BERT-CRF). Removed S-BERT as it's used for retrieval, not generation. Normalized dataset name.
Removed specific metric variants (Head F1, Coref F1) as per normalization rules to keep base forms only. The paper uses Precision, Recall, and F1 as the core metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper; the models are used for generation only.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper; evaluation is entirely automatic.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on event argument extraction using text generation approaches. While it uses generation models (BART), the task is information extraction rather than pure NLG. The evaluation is fully automatic using standard metrics. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed some normalization and filtering of non-generation models.
